Why is this condition being added inside the utility API? The logic to filter out System VPD path should be with caller.
please check the comment.

Currently we are just planning to support System VPD in file mode. Support for other FRUs in file mode is still under analysis. Till that point to remove the overhead from caller's end the check is being added in the utility side.
Acknowledged

should it get changed ? mode based vpd path internally handled.
instead should we add what is the mode ?

with the help of m_vpdModeBasedFruPath we can know the mode. If the system is in file mode, this variable contains the file mode path prefix added to it, else it holds actual base FRU path, so we can know the system is in which mode.
